Class AsyncJobServiceTest

@IsTest
private class AsyncJobServiceTest

Test class for AsyncJobService. Validates methods for checking scheduled jobs, retrieving pending job information, and enqueueing queueable jobs with duplicate prevention and error handling.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void enqueueJobBlankClassNameTest()

Tests the enqueueJob method with a blank className. Verifies that the job is enqueued even when className is blank (bypass duplicate check).

@IsTest
private static void enqueueJobExceptionTest()

Tests the enqueueJob method when an exception occurs during enqueueing. Verifies that the method handles exceptions gracefully by returning null and logging the error.

@IsTest
private static void enqueueJobSuccessTest()

Tests the enqueueJob method with a valid Queueable instance. Verifies that the job is enqueued successfully when the class is not already scheduled.

@IsTest
private static void getPendingJobInfoNoJobTest()

Tests the getPendingJobInfo method when no pending job exists. Verifies that the method returns null when the job is not found.

@IsTest
private static void isClassScheduledTest()

Tests the isClassScheduled method to verify it correctly identifies when a class is not scheduled. Since we cannot easily create AsyncApexJob records in tests, this test verifies the method runs without errors.

@IsTest
private static void scheduledJobInfoTest()

Tests the ScheduledJobInfo wrapper class to verify all properties can be set and retrieved correctly.
